subject: Ensure the daily workflow uses gtest-parallel to run unit tests in isolation (#3375)
reason: The change is purely CI and build infrastructure: it updates .github/workflows/ci.yml and daily.yml to invoke unit tests through the `make test-unit` gtest-parallel target, adds flag plumbing (accurate/large_memory/valgrind/seed, UNIT_TEST_PATTERN) to src/unit/Makefile and src/unit/CMakeLists.txt, and updates src/unit/README.md. No source compiled into valkey-server, valkey-cli, or any other shipped binary is touched, so there is no server or tool behavior for a scenario to reach.
